page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; running head at top; page number at top right; signature at foot. No text in the margins.

main_text.l: Sed videamus, qualem praeterea esse o-
porteat Episcopum. Vigilantem esse vult,
qui in omnibus suae functionis partibus ad-
vigilet, ne quicquam mali ecclesiae Christi
sibi committi contingat, neve insidiator ille
obrepat, ac de Christi castris quid intercipi-
at. Itē [?] Sobrium, vel potius temperantem, & sa-
na mente praeditum. Est enim σωφροσύνη [?], sive σωτηρία [?] ἢ φρονήσεως [?],
sive σώφρονα φρόνησις [?], integra & illaesa mentis constitutio, ne qua fit
parte vel odio, vel invidentia, vel pravo ali-
quo studio, aut aliàs incurabili defectu in-
telligentiae ac judicii vitiata.
Modestum, vel compositū, bonis scil. mo-
ribus decoratum, qui & frugalibus atque
decoris utatur vestibus.
Hospitalem, vel potius amantem hospi-
tium, id est, qui hospites ac peregrinos a-
manter complectatur, & omnibus modis fo-
veat.
Porro sobrietatem, modestiam & hospi-
talitatem etiam eos habere oportet, quibus
praeest (quemadmodum Oecumenius an-
notavit.) Addidit ergo Apostolus, quod ma-
gistri proprium est:
Aptum ad docendum, qui videl.sciat quid,
quibus, quatenus & quomodo docenda sint
quelibet, ut scite ad usum populi accommo-
detur Dei verbum: quique non tantum ar-
tibus ad id necessariis sit excultus, sed etiam
donum Dei tale habens, denique in hoc di-
ligentiam adhibens.

page.notes: Signature reads "Dd z", an old form of 2; transcribed as "Dd 2" with doubt. Greek words are old type with ligatured sigma (printed like Ϛ), transcription of the Greek is uncertain and marked [?]. "Itē" is uncertain: the scan shows a word with a tilde, possibly "Item"; marked [?]. Small pen-like marks in the left margin next to "Modestum" and near the top of the text are not printed text and are omitted. The "I" of "Porro" is a printed initial. "videl.sciat" is printed with a stop after "videl" and is kept as printed. "quelibet" is printed with a q-ligature and is copied as "quelibet" without the expected "quaelibet". Hyphenation "di-ligentiam" is taken from the line break.
